alt: Noma: Ask your database anything. An isometric rack of devices for Ask, Draft, Approve and Answer around a Postgres database.
Noma product: one workspace for every question. An isometric station drafting SQL on its lid.
Noma pricing: pay for seats, not for questions. One isometric tower per plan, Starter, Team and Enterprise.
Noma security: every write waits for a human. A review gate holds an orange write while a blue read passes through.
Noma status: all systems operational. Three isometric region racks with a green heartbeat.
Noma customers: teams that ship answers, not queries. An isometric city of customer towers.
Noma company: the interface between people and their data. Funding rounds drawn as rising isometric bars.
Noma changelog: new in Noma, every other Tuesday. Four isometric release blocks on a rail.
Book a Noma demo: see Noma on your own data. Your Postgres wired to Noma.
Noma raised $48M to give every database a voice. Funding rounds drawn as rising isometric bars.
